value.subject: anchor/gate-main
value.text: They come back down the hall and in through the main gate.

why: The main gate is sealed at beat 25 by a `close-gate` whose `happening` states no subject at all - the beat is about the gate two keys to its left, and the engine reads it there rather than making a creator type it again. This probe gives a later beat that gate as its subject, and the contradiction proof sees a party walking in through a gate that came down twenty beats earlier. Nothing about the perturbed document names the seal: strip the derivation out of the engine and this campaign compiles clean, which is what makes the probe a live proof of the reading rule rather than a demonstration of `DW0485`, which already has one. It declares no unit: `happening` and every one of its fields are bound in the gallery proper, and an ABSENT `subject` is not a surface anybody writes.
